props.title: Millcreek Buildings in 3D
props.snippet: Millcreek's buildings with modelled lidar roof forms, shaded by median roof height on the city's lidar terrain. Unvalidated planning estimates; not surveyed or field-verified.
props.description:
Planning estimates. Everything here comes from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023) and the City of Millcreek's processing of it. These are unvalidated planning estimates, not surveyed or field-verified data. Do not use them for engineering, legal or property decisions.

Millcreek's buildings with modelled lidar roof forms, shaded by median roof height on the city's lidar terrain. Select a building for its model source, heights and available roof measurements. Use the slides for a tour, or drag to look around.

Built on the web scene 5b5bdf4a63c9466fad5884039aa7357f; each layer's own page describes how it was made, its fields and its limits.

Questions or corrections: City of Millcreek GIS.
props.accessInformation: City of Millcreek GIS; 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP); building footprints: Salt Lake County (Assessor and Surveyor)
props.licenseInfo:
These data are unvalidated planning estimates produced by City of Millcreek GIS from 2023 lidar. They are not surveyed, engineered or field-verified, and must not be used to determine property boundaries or ownership, building or site design, engineering, flood or drainage design, code compliance (including building height), or any legal or regulatory determination. They are provided as is, without warranty of accuracy, completeness or fitness for any purpose; check conditions on the ground before relying on them. Credit "City of Millcreek GIS; 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (USGS 3DEP)" when you use or show them.

Salt Lake County data. The building footprints and their County attributes come from Salt Lake County (Assessor and Surveyor). The County's own terms apply to them: the County states that its footprints are not field verified, are for general reference only, and are not intended to determine property ownership, final building and site design or jurisdictional boundaries, or to replace a certified topographical or boundary survey or any other legal document.
